brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors; all seven RC items met through sustained multi-turn engagement. Three high-order points completed: HO1 (cervical screening misunderstanding corrected with teach-back approach), HO2 (hidden pathology uncertainty discovered and problem-listed), and HO3 (balanced false-negative/false-positive avoidance). Closure is valid_open with ongoing follow-up path. All dimensions good or above.
